description: MCP server for Quantinuum Nexus, wrapping the qnexus SDK. Not affiliated with Quantinuum.
name: io.github.Blite-HQ/qnexus-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Hard per-call HQC ceiling; 0 blocks all spend (default: 0).
environmentVariables.name: QNEXUS_MCP_MAX_CREDITS

environmentVariables.description: Top-N cap on distinct measurement outcomes returned per result item (default: 100).
environmentVariables.name: QNEXUS_MCP_MAX_OUTCOMES

environmentVariables.description: Sliding-window submission cap; each circuit in a batch counts as one (default: 6).
environmentVariables.name: QNEXUS_MCP_MAX_SUBMISSIONS_PER_MINUTE

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated project allowlist, enforced on every mutating tool (default: all projects).
environmentVariables.name: QNEXUS_MCP_PROJECTS
